description: Allow-list of identities permitted to record an independent CONTROL_TOWER_AUDIT acceptance. An independent auditor MUST be a distinct GitHub identity from the PR author and from every worker account. This list is intentionally EMPTY until a genuinely independent collaborator account, or a verifiable trusted GitHub App, is provisioned. While it is empty the integration gate fails closed: no acceptance can be authorized, because a same-account or self marker is never independent. Do NOT add a worker account or the shared authoring account here to unblock integration.
